ra: Shamash/Sun is one of the seven planetary deities of the Harranian heptad (Green; Fihrist).
Sin/Moon is the supreme member of the Harranian planetary heptad (Green).
Kronos/Saturn is one of the seven planetary deities of Harran (Green; Fihrist).
Zeus/Jupiter is one of the seven planetary deities of Harran (Green; Fihrist).
Ares/Mars is one of the seven planetary deities of Harran (Green; Fihrist).
Aphrodite/Venus is one of the seven planetary deities of Harran (Green; Fihrist).
Hermes-Nabu/Mercury is one of the seven planetary deities of Harran (Green; Fihrist).
The Harranian Sun-deity is the late continuation of Mesopotamian Utu/Shamash (ancient identification / cult continuity; Green).
Greco-Roman sources and the Sabians themselves identified the Harranian Sun with Helios (interpretatio; Green).
Functional alignment between the Harranian solar deity and the Picatrix Spirit of the Sun (al-Shams) in the shared Arabic planetary-magic milieu.
The Sabian Moon-cult of Harran is the direct continuation of the Aramean Sin of Harran into late antiquity (Green).
The Harranian Moon-god derives from and is identified with Mesopotamian Nanna/Sin (cult continuity; Green).
Greco-Roman interpretatio identified the Harranian Moon with Selene (Green).
Functional alignment with the Picatrix Spirit of the Moon (al-Qamar) in the shared planetary-magic milieu.
The Harranian Saturn-deity is explicitly identified with Greek Kronos (interpretatio; Fihrist, Green).
Saturn in the Mesopotamian-Harranian astral scheme corresponds to Ninurta/Ninib (planetary identification; Green).
Functional alignment with the Picatrix Spirit of Saturn (Zuhal).
The Harranian Jupiter-deity is identified with Greek Zeus (interpretatio; Green).
Jupiter in the Mesopotamian-Harranian astral scheme corresponds to Marduk/Bel (planetary identification; Green).
Functional alignment with the Picatrix Spirit of Jupiter (al-Mushtari).
The Harranian Mars-deity is identified with Greek Ares (interpretatio; Green).
Mars in the Mesopotamian-Harranian astral scheme is Nergal, god of war and the underworld (planetary identification; Green).
Functional alignment with the Picatrix Spirit of Mars (al-Mirrikh).
The Harranian Venus-deity is identified with Greek Aphrodite (interpretatio; Green).
Venus in the Mesopotamian-Harranian astral scheme is Inanna/Ishtar, the planet's ancient owner (planetary identification; Green).
Functional alignment with the Picatrix Spirit of Venus (al-Zuhra).
The Harranian Mercury-deity is identified with Greek Hermes (interpretatio; Green).
Mercury in the Mesopotamian-Harranian astral scheme is Nabu, scribal god of wisdom (planetary identification; Green).
Functional alignment with the Picatrix Spirit of Mercury (Utarid).
The Harranian Sabians received Hermes Trismegistus of the Greco-Egyptian Hermetica as their founding prophet-sage (Green; Fihrist).
Harranian and Islamic sources identified the prophet Hermes with Qur'anic Idris (=Enoch), which secured the Sabians' protected status under Islam (Green).
The Harranian prophet-sage Agathodaimon is the Harranian reception of the pan-Hermetic Agathos Daimon (homonym; same figure received into the Sabian prophetic tradition; Green).
Agathodaimon is grouped with the Harranian prophetic/teaching tradition surrounding the planetary cult; weak roster linkage to the cult-hub (Fihrist tradition; Green).
Agathodaimon is consistently paired with Hermes as a teacher-sage in the Hermetic and Harranian Sabian tradition (Green).
Agathodaimon as Harranian revelatory 'Good Spirit' parallels the Hermetic revealer-figure tradition exemplified by Poimandres (conceptual reception; Corpus Hermeticum).
The soul's ascent passes through the spheres of the seven planetary deities, binding the doctrine to the cult-heptad (Green).
The planetary-ascent schema follows the Poimandres account (CH I) of the soul shedding planetary qualities on its return to the divine; this is the Hermetic source of the Harranian doctrine (Green).
The planetary temples of Harran were each dedicated to one of the seven planetary deities, in distinctive geometric forms keyed to each planet (Fihrist; Green).
The Harranian planetary-temple/talismanic scheme is part of the same Arabic astral-magic complex that the Picatrix's seven planetary spirits draw on (shared milieu; Green).
